description: This file contains configuration functions for setting up Vitest testing environment for the 'bluebubbles' extension, including loading inclusion patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for testing from environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE', or returns null if not set.

methods.name: export function createExtensionBlueBubblesVitestConfig( createExtensionBlueBubblesVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the 'bluebubbles' extension, setting up test patterns and environment.
